answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Thread. Each new identity must solve a fresh challenge derived from the prior identity's signed answer, forming a thread that only extends forward. Because every answer seeds the next challenge, an attacker cannot precompute solutions or replay one across many sockpuppets; each costs a live sequential solve, and the pearl of verified work must be embedded in the signature. The cost is serialized compute per identity plus a growing karst of stored state the attacker must maintain to keep fakes consistent.
